Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Rep. Greg Casar): the FastDemocracy listing (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/) lists 12 cosponsors, all Democrats where party is shown, and Emmer is not among them; Congress.gov was not checked this time (it returned HTTP 403 in the earlier attempt), so this rests on a third-party listing. Kept from the earlier attempt, when the official site was opened directly: the home page and the first four pages of press releases (https://emmer.house.gov/media-center/press-releases?page=0 to ?page=3), covering 40 releases from 20 January 2026 to 23 October 2026, have no titles or visible excerpts mentioning AI, artificial intelligence, superintelligence, data centers or chips (full texts not opened), and his issue pages list blockchain and crypto but not AI. 2025 releases were not checked page by page. No House letter about AI risk led or signed by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions).
